doctrine.is: The main lattice looking at its own limbs. Autonomous pulse, self-audit, versioned future slots.
doctrine.rule: Empty is honest. Named shadows stay named. Future slots wait until a public GET proves them. Human remains publisher for git, HF ingest of Pages, and Star Chart steward ingest.

self_audit.aligned_when: All CANON slots live, star chain valid, agora feed_root matches chain_root.
self_audit.drift_when: Overview older than 10 days, a CANON miss, or agora/star root mismatch.
self_audit.shadow_when: Star chain break or majority CANON slots unreachable.

future_ready.rule: Add a slot in slots.json. FUTURE never fails the kernel. When GET + expected signature succeed, the slot promotes to LIVE without a rewrite of the canvas.
